# ButterflyFx, Kenneth W. Bingham

> An AI engineer's site where nothing is asserted without something you can run. The work is
> retrieval, pipelines and evaluation; the research is about holding data as geometry and deriving
> it on demand instead of storing it. Every claim on this site has its boundary printed next to it,
> including the places the method loses.

## Start here

- [The case for geometry as data](https://butterflyfx.us/the-case.html): the whole argument in one
  page, with benchmarks that run in the browser tab you are reading it in. One surface, z = x times
  y, used three ways: asked questions instead of searched, read as a complete set of logic gates,
  and repaired from its own neighbours with no master copy. Section 03 states plainly why this is
  not compression, and the two things that claim does not say.
- [Geometry as a data source](https://butterflyfx.us/geometry-as-data.html): the whitepaper, with
  fourteen reproducible proofs and the honest limits.
- [Run the benchmark](https://butterflyfx.us/geometry-bench.html): on the sample data or on a file
  you drop in. Lossless and hash verified every time.

## Demonstrations you can break

- [Paint by numbers](https://butterflyfx.us/paint-by-numbers.html): how much of a photograph one
  simple rule can paint, and the exact remainder it cannot.
- [Self healing lattice](https://butterflyfx.us/self-healing.html): damage it by hand and watch the
  neighbours put it back.
- [The shape of a file](https://butterflyfx.us/shape-of-a-file.html): any file drawn as a surface,
  showing where its structure is and where it is only noise.

## Who and how

- [About](https://butterflyfx.us/about.html) and [Resume](https://butterflyfx.us/resume.html).
- [Method](https://butterflyfx.us/method.html): verify first, label what is measured and what is
  framing, and never present an untested idea as a finding.
- [Directing AI](https://butterflyfx.us/directing-ai.html): why direction that requires judgement
  beats instruction that removes it.
- [Contact](https://butterflyfx.us/contact.html).

## What is claimed, and what is not

- Holding data as a generator plus a remainder is lossless and hash verified, and what it saves is
  exactly the amount of geometry the data actually has: two orders of magnitude on generated fields,
  a few percent on photographs, and nothing at all on random bytes.
- It is not a better general purpose compressor, and nothing here gets around the Kolmogorov bound.
- On real photographs, PNG beat every scheme tested.
- Deriving rather than storing saves memory and is slower than a local read, about four and a half
  times slower, while beating a remote fetch by about a hundred times. Both halves are always stated.
- None of it is new mathematics and none of it overturns any. It is known mathematics presented
  dimensionally.

## Elsewhere

- [zeqxy.com](https://zeqxy.com): the teaching side of the same idea, with three browser tools for
  seeing what an expression looks like in 3D.
